title: A refused playback decision line does not say whether a copy or a re-encode was refused
notes: JS-153 minor. The refused line carries one refusal reason and no asked method, where a direct play that gave up a transcode carries asked and asked_reasons. WorkersAtCopyBound implies a copy; NoWorkerWithFreeCores, NoWorkerRunning and RememberedFailure do not say. An operator sizing workers cannot tell a cheap copy refused from a re-encode refused without looking up the film. Refusals on the dogfood: unverified. Promote as a criterion (the refused line and jellyscale_playbackinfo_refusals_total carry what was asked, with its reasons) when jellyscale_playbackinfo_refusals_total on the dogfood is above zero for a reason that does not name the method, or when JS-154's decision chooses refusing with a reason: the task that does it carries the criterion. D-041.
